findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Update parent epic (9109-2ad9-2477-4cf6) AC5 to match the amended standard the operator approved at the leaf level before closing this story, so the parent's plan-review attestation is re-issued against the corrected criterion.
evidence: Parent AC5: 'demonstrated by a real rebar review-plan run whose output contains that move. That output MUST be committed in the same change (docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md)'

Leaf AC5 (amended): 'the original wording required a run whose output CONTAINS the coaching move, which is not achievable through the overlay … What is therefore required and met: (i) the criterion FIRES on a real hand-enumerated plan, at validity 1.0 … (ii) the move is proven APPLICABLE … (iii) the selection limitation is documented rather than presented as met'

G7 conflict rule: 'On any conflict between the leaf and the parent, the parent's plan is authoritative … update the parent first (which stales the parent's own plan-review attestation and forces its re-review)'
findings.finding: The leaf's amended AC5 redefines a parent acceptance criterion. Parent AC5 requires 'a real rebar review-plan run whose output CONTAINS that move'; the leaf's AC5 substitutes a weaker standard (criterion fires + move proven applicable + selection limitation documented) justified by the claim the original is 'not achievable through the overlay'. Under G7 the parent wins; the leaf may not resolve a parent AC by weakening it — the parent's AC5 must be updated first (which stales the parent's plan-review attestation and forces its re-review), and only then may the leaf close against the revised standard.
findings.location: Leaf AC5 (amended) vs. Parent epic 9109-2ad9-2477-4cf6 AC5
scenarios: A reviewer or CI check validates the leaf against the parent's AC5 and flags it as unmet, because the committed run log does not show the coaching move being selected in output.
A future child story assumes the parent's AC5 was met as written, and relies on the coaching move being demonstrably selectable — a guarantee the leaf's amended evidence does not provide.
findings.suggested_fix: In parent epic 9109, amend AC5 to read: 'A project-only criterion + coaching move exists such that a review finding fires on a hand-enumerated plan at validity 1.0 (naming the string-literal site the LSP cannot resolve); the move is proven APPLICABLE via deterministic overlay tests; that the advisory move is not LLM-selected when blocking built-ins also fire is documented in docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md and in the ticket comments.' Then re-run plan-review on the parent to re-attest it, and only then close the leaf against the revised AC.
